blends.name: 🛠️ Salvage Yard — Lab Dismantling Unit
blends.desc:
Hidden inside the larger CleanupCentr Salvage Yard, the Salvage Lab is where worn EcoFlame Incinerators undergo precision dismantling. Unlike the chaotic scrap piles outside, the Lab operates with controlled robotics and cold blue engineering lights—designed to recover whatever components survive the breakdown.

This is the same facility where the reclaimed parts are sorted and shipped out to become EcoTools Crates. Every crate originates here, forged from the metal plating, internal machinery, and salvaged mechanisms extracted during these dismantling cycles.

Most incinerators yield only enough intact components for two restored eco-tools, and only occasionally does the Lab recover a surviving Simple Core. Those recovered cores are the rare bonus finds players sometimes discover inside EcoTools Crates.

This blend represents one of those controlled dismantling cycles inside the Salvage Lab—the origin point of every EcoTools Crate and every refurbished tool within the CleanupCentr ecosystem.

blends.name: 🌾 Common Plot
blends.desc:
🌱 **Common Plot**

The foundation of every sustainable farm, the Common Plot is a regenerated stretch of soil reborn through bio-engineering.

Forged by fusing three units of EcoFusion Compost with 323000 TOMATOE tokens, this fertile terrain embodies the harmony between biological decay and renewable energy.

Compost restores the earth’s organic memory, while TOMATOE infuses it with vital energy—reactivating dormant microbes and awakening the ground’s natural pulse.

Once formed, the Common Plot becomes a living substrate for CINDER-powered seeds, capable of supporting balanced growth and sustainable harvests.

🌿 *Where compost meets energy, new life begins.*
